evidence: Listing shows "共 8 个非遗项目" and all 8 items are displayed in the grid: 春节, 端午龙舟, 剪纸, 京剧, 昆曲, 书法, 苏绣, 宜兴紫砂
All 8 items belong to one of 4 supported categories: Traditional Crafts (传统工艺: 2 items), Performing Arts (传统表演: 2 items), Folk Activities (民俗活动: 2 items), Traditional Art (传统美术: 2 items)
Each card displays: title (heading), brief description (paragraph), region (location badge), and category badge. Example: 春节 card shows "春节是中国最重要的传统节日..." + "北京 · 华夏大地" + "民俗活动" category
Detail page displays: title (春节), full introduction, category (民俗活动), region (北京 · 华夏大地), year (2006年入选), and gallery with 3 selectable images. Main image displays failure prompt as expected.

Image gallery selection works: clicking thumbnails updates selection state. Tested: clicked thumb 2 (became selected), then thumb 3 (became selected, others deselected). All 3 images are individually selectable.
Clicking "浏览更多项目" from detail page returned to homepage project list showing all 8 items. Category navigation works correctly.
Search, filter by category, and sort by year all work. Tested search "苏绣", filter "传统工艺" (2→1 item), sort "按年份". Result count updates accurately from 8→2→1 items.
Filter (传统工艺), sort (按年份), and search (苏绣) all persisted after visiting detail page and returning. Result count remained "共 1 个非遗项目".
Clicking hotspot opens information overlay with: title (苏绣), image, category (传统工艺), region (江苏 · 江南水乡), year (2006年入选), brief description, gallery (3 images), and "查看详情" link.
Zoomed panorama to show 2 hotspots, navigated to detail page, returned via "返回全景探索" button. Panorama still shows same 2 hotspots, confirming zoom level was restored.

Panorama supports full 360° rotation (verified via pointer events simulation). Zooming in (4→2 hotspots) and out (2→4 hotspots) shows hotspots are dynamic but not permanently lost. Tested clicking hotspots after zoom - they remain interactive. Hotspots reappear when zooming out.

Invalid URL /heritage/invalid-project-id shows clear not-found message: "未找到该非遗项目". Valid URL /heritage/peking-opera displays correct item with title (京剧), category (传统表演), region (北京 · 京城古韵), year (2010年入选), and description.

Images are clearly labeled by heritage item name: 京剧 (Peking Opera), 书法 (Calligraphy), 苏绣 (Suzhou Embroidery). Image gallery thumbnails consistently named "[Item] thumbnail N". Item descriptions match image context and names. Gallery shows relevant images for each heritage item.
